title: A design can be SKIPPED: the aggregate records the skip and the decoder refuses a half-skipped revision
description:
SPIDR prerequisite of task-de0598236f3b4d95aa3b6098b9d56995 (architect-b63fabf3, 2026-09-05), cut on the DATA axis. That row measured at ~10 distinct files with two of them already at or over the per-file cap; this row carries the one piece that had no home at all.

HUMAN DECISION, 2026-09-05, taken in the REPL after the architect measured that the toggle had no precedent (`git grep -ln 'skipDesign|GoalSettings|perGoal' -- apps/daemon/src` = ZERO hits) and that its obvious home was closed: `goal.create`'s payload is exact-arity `["instructions","title"]` (daemon-command-vocabulary.ts:295), so widening it is a separate multi-file roster job on the critical path. The human chose: RECORD THE SKIP ON THE EXISTING DESIGN AGGREGATE. No new command kind, no new aggregate, no vocabulary or registry backfill. The alternatives considered and rejected were widening `goal.create` (roster job) and a project-level flag (would have forced DoD-6 of the parent to be rewritten from "per-goal" to "per-project").

OBJECTIVE: make "this goal plans without a design" a durable, readable fact on `design:<goalId>`.

DELIVERABLE WHEN DONE: a design revision can carry a SKIPPED marker; `designRead` answers it; and a revision that is half-skipped - marked skipped while still carrying sections, or marked un-skipped while carrying none - is REFUSED with a stable code and its layer.

MEASURED AT HEAD f3b94eaa (branch moe/work-2026-09-04) by architect-b63fabf3:
- `apps/daemon/src/design/` holds 9 files landed by task-5e90317e (DONE, sha 34baaf52, reviewed: 48 tests, three drills). This row extends that contract; it does not rewrite it.
- `design-contracts.ts:39` `DESIGN_REVISION_KEYS` = `["apiSurface","componentList","dataModel","nonFunctional","openDecisions","screens"]` - SIX keys, `/** Sorted, and compared by exact arity. */`.
- `design-contracts.ts:44` `DESIGN_SECTION_KEYS` = the FIVE sections, `/** named apart from openDecisions so a dropped one names itself */`.
- `exactDesignRecord` at :150 and `decodeDesignRevision` at :232 are the arity gate. `DESIGN_CODE_LAYERS` at :65 is the closed code->layer map; `designRefusal` at :120 takes the CODE only and reads the layer from that map, so a call site structurally cannot mint a disagreeing pair. Use it; never pass a layer literal.
- THE BLAST RADIUS IS CONTAINED AND MEASURED: `git grep -ln 'DESIGN_REVISION_KEYS|DESIGN_SECTION_KEYS|openDecisions' -- . ':!.moe'` returns exactly FOUR files, all under apps/daemon/src/design/ - design-contracts.ts, design-contracts.test.ts, design-store.test.ts, design-test-fixtures.ts. Nothing outside that directory names the revision keys.
- `design-records.ts:31` `DESIGN_RECORD_KEYS` does NOT mirror the revision keys (`revision` is one key), so the RECORD shape is untouched by this row.
- `design.submit` / `design.read` are NOT yet published on any command roster (`git grep -n 'design\.submit|design\.read'` hits only design-store.ts:155, a record field). That publication is task-06ac0da1's and this row does NOT need it: this row changes a decoder and its aggregate, not a wire.

THE HAZARD THAT DEFINES THIS ROW: `DESIGN_REVISION_KEYS` is compared by EXACT ARITY. Adding a seventh key makes every existing six-key revision payload REFUSE - every fixture, every test arm, every future caller. That is not a side effect to absorb quietly; it is the main event. Either the new key is genuinely required on every revision (and all four files move together in one commit), or the decode admits both arities deliberately and a test pins WHICH. Decide it at plan time, say which in the completion record, and drill it: a six-key revision must still round-trip, or must refuse with a named code - never silently.

NOT IN SCOPE - owned by named rows:
- The affordance surface reading this marker to skip the step - the successor row filed alongside this one.
- The wrapper staffing a design seat, and any mission text - task-de0598236f3b4d95aa3b6098b9d56995.
- Publishing `design.submit`/`design.read` on the command roster or over MCP - task-06ac0da1 and task-7f9f20c7.
- Any UI - task-8a6d6660's child 3.

VERIFICATION COMMAND for moe.complete_task: `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon exec vitest run --root . --config package.json --maxWorkers=4 --testTimeout=30000 src/design` (the shape task-5e90317e used and QA reproduced; `Test Files 2 passed (2)` / `Tests 48 passed (48)` was its baseline). Also run `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test` and `pnpm typecheck` and quote their count lines.
definitionOfDone: A design revision can be marked SKIPPED on the `design:<goalId>` aggregate, and `designRead` answers that marker distinguishably from both "no design has ever been submitted" and "a real design exists". Assert all THREE states against a real store built by the production journey (the pattern task-5e90317e used), not against a hand-built fixture object - a two-state assertion cannot tell a skip from an absent read, which is the exact confusion this row exists to remove.

The arity decision is MADE, PINNED and DRILLED. `DESIGN_REVISION_KEYS` is compared by exact arity (design-contracts.ts:39 comment, enforced at `exactDesignRecord`:150), so a seventh key changes what every existing payload decodes to. State in the completion record which rule you chose - required-on-every-revision, or both arities admitted - and pin it with a test that asserts a SIX-key revision's outcome by name (round-trips, or refuses with a specific code). `expect(result.ok).toBe(false)` alone does not satisfy this clause.

A HALF-SKIPPED revision is refused with a stable code AND its layer asserted: marked skipped while still carrying sections, and marked un-skipped while carrying no sections. The code comes through `designRefusal(<code>)` so the layer is read from `DESIGN_CODE_LAYERS` (design-contracts.ts:65) - a layer string literal at any throw site is a defect, because `designRefusal` accepts no layer argument precisely so no call site can mint a disagreeing pair. If a NEW code is added, it joins that closed map and `DESIGN_CODES` derives from the map's keys, never from a second hand-written list.

All four measured consumers move in the SAME commit and none is left decoding the old arity: apps/daemon/src/design/design-contracts.ts, design-contracts.test.ts, design-store.test.ts, design-test-fixtures.ts. Re-run `git grep -ln 'DESIGN_REVISION_KEYS|DESIGN_SECTION_KEYS|openDecisions' -- . ':!.moe'` at the delivered tree and confirm it still returns exactly those four - a fifth consumer appearing mid-flight is a stop-and-report, not an extra path to take.

MUTATION DRILL, quoted with its failing line, restored and proved: flip the skipped/sections consistency check so a half-skipped revision is admitted, and confirm the arm from DoD-3 goes RED naming the code (not merely "threw"). `git status --porcelain` the mutated paths FIRST; every file here is TRACKED so an empty `git diff -- <path>` is a valid restore proof, in a call SEPARATE from the restore - say so explicitly rather than leaving global rail 13 unaddressed.

Gates quoted with their `Test Files N passed` count lines: `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon exec vitest run --root . --config package.json --maxWorkers=4 --testTimeout=30000 src/design`, `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test`, `pnpm typecheck`. Root `pnpm test` is NOT evidence here and must not be quoted as such - vitest.config.ts:32 includes no `apps/**`, so it runs zero tests against this row's files. Attribute any foreign red by the merge-base/HEAD failing-path delta intersected with apps/daemon/src/design/.
taskRails: DATA SHAPE ONLY, INSIDE apps/daemon/src/design/. This row publishes no command kind, offers no affordance step, staffs no seat and writes no mission text. If a step needs the surface or the wrapper to be meaningful, it belongs to a successor row - say so and move on.

EXACT ARITY IS THE POINT, NOT AN OBSTACLE. `DESIGN_REVISION_KEYS` is compared by arity, so a seventh key redefines every existing payload's outcome. Do not work around it by loosening `exactDesignRecord` for everything - that would silently admit unknown keys on every design and delete the guarantee task-5e90317e shipped.

REFUSALS COME THROUGH `designRefusal(<code>)`, which reads the layer from the closed `DESIGN_CODE_LAYERS` map and accepts no layer argument. A layer string literal at a throw site is a defect even when it happens to be the right string.

This row EXTENDS a DONE row's contract (task-5e90317e, sha 34baaf52). Read its reviewSummary before editing: three drills and 48 tests already guard this directory. Do not delete or weaken an existing arm to make a new one fit.
FEATURES ONLY (inherited): no security-boundary or policy work.
